scripts.analytics:import:ui: node scripts/copy-junit.mjs playwright-java-bdd com.srlink.playwright.bdd.ui.RunCucumberUiTest && analytics-dashboard import reports/junit/playwright-java-bdd.xml --format junit-xml --tool playwright-java-bdd --application-type UI --methodology BDD --config dashboard.config.ts
scripts.analytics:import:api: node scripts/copy-junit.mjs playwright-java-api-bdd com.srlink.playwright.bdd.api.RunCucumberApiTest && analytics-dashboard import reports/junit/playwright-java-api-bdd.xml --format junit-xml --tool playwright-java-api-bdd --application-type API --methodology BDD --config dashboard.config.ts
scripts.analytics:run:ui: npm run test:ui && npm run analytics:import:ui && npm run analytics:generate
scripts.analytics:run:api: npm run test:api && npm run analytics:import:api && npm run analytics:generate
